NONE: › a use of language in which a word that has more than one meaning is used with one meaning in one part of a sentence and with a different meaning in another part of the sentence, usually in order to produce a humorous effect
軛式搭配法（指一個多義詞在句子的某一部分使用該詞的一個意思，而在句子的另一部分使用該詞的另一個意思，從而達到幽默的效果）

example: "She filed her nails and then she filed a complaint against her boss" is an example of the figure of speech known as zeugma.
在「She filed her nails and then she filed a complaint against her boss」這個句子中，file的用法是修辭手段「軛式搭配法」的一個例子。
